# RMarkdown REPORT

---
  title: "WEAWAVeS End-of-day Report"
date: "`r params$survey_date`"
output:
  html_document:
  toc: true
toc_float: true
theme: cosmo
params:
  survey_date: NULL
gps_effort: NULL
effort_summary: NULL
sight_daily: NULL
sight_cum: NULL
transects: NULL
---

# Setup

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(knitr)

Survey Maps


leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.OceanBasemap) %>%
  
  addPolylines(
    data = params$transects,
    color = "grey",
    weight = 1,
    opacity = 0.4,
    group = "Planned Transects"
  ) %>%
  
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = params$sight_daily,
    lng = ~as.numeric(Sgt_lon),
    lat = ~as.numeric(Sgt_lat),
    radius = 4,
    color = "purple",
    popup = ~paste(Species, "Count:", Best_count),
    group = "Sightings"
  )


Effort Summary


kable(
  params$effort_summary %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 1))),
  caption = "Daily Effort (km)"
)


Daily Sightings


daily_summary <- params$sight_daily %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    sightings = n(),
    total_count = sum(as.numeric(Best_count), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(daily_summary, caption = "Daily Sightings Summary")


Cumulative Sightings

kable(
  params$sight_cum,
  caption = "Cumulative Sightings Summary"
)

PSD Histogram

psd_df <- params$sight_daily %>%
  mutate(PSD = as.numeric(`PSD (m)`)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(PSD))

ggplot(psd_df, aes(x = PSD)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 100) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Perpendicular Sighting Distance (PSD)", x = "Distance (m)")
